title: Please check out this free Game i made with ai - Update！
author: PlaceholderTestAcc
selftext:
The original game was barebones and lacked a decent gameplay loop，so i updated it

A lot more Content than Before，and with it comes many more additions！

\-Numerous bug fixes 

\-New mechanics

\-New Entities 

\-Locker system to store things in the command room 

\-Save file 

\-A special mode for the gun. 

\-A guide 

[https://mfcproductions.github.io/Sector-3---1.2/](https://mfcproductions.github.io/Sector-3---1.2/) 

To Find the guide on how to play，press pause and click on “Field manual” Visual Demonstrations are also provided. 

Tell me what you think，What bugs you counter，and what you want to see more of，thanks！
